mapper.select: SELECT account_id, default_account_id, notification_channel, contact_email, contact_phone, display_currency, theme, avatar_key, updated_on FROM customer_preferences WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO customer_preferences (account_id, default_account_id, notification_channel, contact_email, contact_phone, updated_on) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{defaultAccountId}, #{notificationChannel}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET notification_channel = EXCLUDED.notification_channel, contact_email = EXCLUDED.contact_email, contact_phone = EXCLUDED.contact_phone, updated_on = NOW()

INSERT INTO customer_preferences (account_id, default_account_id, display_currency, theme, updated_on) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{defaultAccountId}, #{displayCurrency}, #{theme}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET display_currency = EXCLUDED.display_currency, theme = EXCLUDED.theme, updated_on = NOW()

INSERT INTO customer_preferences (account_id, default_account_id, avatar_key, updated_on) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{defaultAccountId}, #{avatarKey}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET avatar_key = EXCLUDED.avatar_key, updated_on = NOW()
